privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.metaTitle: Privacy Policy | Sree Hari Saradha Vidhyalaya Matriculation School
privacyPage.metaDesc: Privacy Policy of Sree Hari Saradha Vidhyalaya Matriculation School (S.H.S.V.M School) in Pakkam, Thiruvallur District, Tamil Nadu.
privacyPage.sec1P1: Welcome to Sree Hari Saradha Vidhyalaya Matriculation School (S.H.S.V.M School). We respect the privacy of our students, parents, guardians, and website visitors, and are committed to protecting your personal data.
privacyPage.sec1P2: This Privacy Policy informs you how we collect, handle, and safeguard your personal data when you visit our website, submit admission enquiries, or communicate with our school administration, and tells you about your privacy rights.
privacyPage.sec2Intro: We may collect, use, store, and transfer different kinds of personal data when you interact with our website or contact our admissions desk:
privacyPage.sec2Identity: Identity Data: Includes student and parent/guardian full names, relationship to student, date of birth, and grade applied for.
privacyPage.sec2Contact: Contact Data: Includes mobile phone numbers, WhatsApp numbers, email addresses, and residential address in Pakkam, Thiruvallur, or nearby areas.
privacyPage.sec2Enquiry: Academic & Enquiry Data: Includes previous schooling details, academic grade enquiries (Primary, Upper Primary, Secondary), and communication preferences.
privacyPage.sec2Technical: Technical Data: Includes internet protocol (IP) address, browser type and version, time zone setting, operating system, and general device information.
privacyPage.sec3Intro: We will only use your personal data for legitimate educational and administrative purposes, specifically:
privacyPage.sec3U1: To register, evaluate, and follow up on student admission enquiries submitted through our website.
privacyPage.sec3U2: To provide counselling, academic guidance, and follow-up support requested by parents.
privacyPage.sec3U3: To communicate important school announcements, academic schedules, and admission milestones.
privacyPage.sec3U4: To administer and protect our website, including troubleshooting, system maintenance, and data security.
privacyPage.sec4P: We have implemented appropriate security measures to prevent your personal data from being accidentally lost, used or accessed in an unauthorized way, altered, or disclosed. Access to personal enquiry data is limited strictly to authorized school administrators and admissions personnel of Sree Hari Saradha Vidhyalaya.
privacyPage.sec5Intro: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or our privacy practices, please contact our administrative office:
privacyPage.sec5School: Sree Hari Saradha Vidhyalaya Matriculation School (S.H.S.V.M School)
privacyPage.sec5Address: Korattur Thinnanur Periyapalayam Road (SH-50A), Pakkam, Thiruvallur District, Tamil Nadu 602024
privacyPage.sec5Timings: Office Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM – 5:30 PM (Sunday closed)
